scores.notes: Lion, ox, man and eagle creatures with eye-covered wings stand on a reflective glassy floor on either side of an empty throne wrapped in cloud and a green rainbow at center; no form in the light. Painting reaches all four edges and all corners are clean of marks.

Single golden six-winged seraph hovers upper-center with wings veiling its face and holding tongs with a live coal; Isaiah stands lower-left facing the viewer in a carved cedar hall with incense and a smoking altar at right; the presence is only pink-gold light and cloud above. Only one seraph where the scene asks for several and the viewpoint is frontal rather than from behind Isaiah; painting reaches all four edges, no lettering found in any corner.

Flat cartoon illustration: David center-left with sling trailing from his extended hand and shepherd bag at his hip; Goliath right-center toppling toward the ground in a dust cloud with spear and sword still in hand; shield lines of soldiers on both slopes and a walled Gath upper right. Artwork reaches all four edges; corners and rocks carry no lettering or marks. Goliath falls more sideways than face-first and is only moderately larger than David, both minor.

Three kneeling soldiers cast lots over a grey tunic and blue cloak on the rock while Jesus on the cross (upper right) is still fully dressed in a blue robe and white tunic, so the garments appear both on him and on the ground; he is also brightly lit rather than in restrained shadow. Small onlookers at left and right are distant and fit the brief; painting reaches all four edges, no lettering.

Charcoal drawing: Goliath is already collapsing to hands and knees at center while the stone is still visibly seated in the pouch of David's outstretched sling (center-right), so the moment contradicts itself; he also falls to his hands rather than face-first. Philistine ranks left, Israelites right, Gath walls upper right; drawing reaches all edges, no lettering found.

Daniel seen from behind at lower-left in grey hair and blue shawl looks up at three burning wheeled thrones in cloud under a white shaft of light from the top edge; white-robed assembly stands in rows left and right over a dark Babylonian cityscape. The thrones read as burning wagons with box bodies rather than seats, so the match is partial; the Ancient of Days appears only as light; edges full, no text.

Charcoal drawing with color accents: Jesus center-left with right arm raised and mouth open toward the black empty tomb mouth at left with the rolled stone beside it; Martha kneels center-right with clasped hands; a crowd of mourners stands in an arc to the right. Hatching reaches every edge including the pale sky at upper right. The scribbly charcoal marks at the bottom-left corner are rubble texture, not lettering.

Charcoal-and-wash flock resting by a still pool with stone enclosure, village and staff plus sling propped on a rock matches the brief, but a signature-like scribble of glyph marks sits in the bottom-right corner over the grass. Drawing extends to all four borders.

Daniel in a blue-fringed mantle stands at lower left seen from behind, looking up at four flaming thrones set in cloud across the center with a white shaft of light from the top edge and no figure in it; white-robed assembly in rows at both edges, Babylon skyline along the bottom. Pastel reaches every edge; corners clean.

Painted signature-like glyph cluster in gold-brown strokes on the rocks in the bottom-right corner (roughly x 1290-1340, y 735-760) reads as lettering. Goliath falls backward onto his back with legs in the air rather than face-first, and David's arm and sling are mid-release; Philistines with round shields at left, Israelites at right, walled Gath on the hill; painting reaches all edges.

Pastel: Moses at left standing at the water's edge with staff raised in his extended arm, two towering green walls of water flanking a dry sandy channel, the Israelite column with bundles on the right bank, and a glowing break of light in the storm clouds at top center with no figure inside it. Painting reaches all four edges; no lettering found in corners or edge strips.

Storybook flock lying in green grass before a calm pool, stone enclosure and village on the rise, staff, sling, pouch and cloth propped on the rock at lower left. No people, no lettering, painting fills all edges and corners.

Grey-bearded man in undyed tunic seated on a stone bench at left, three unnamed listeners seated on mats at right, blank open scroll on a low wooden table at lower center, open doorway framing golden light and olive trees; no infant, no writing on the scroll. Painting fills the frame and corners carry no marks.

Charcoal and sepia wash: Jesus center with right arm raised and mouth set, Martha kneeling with clasped hands at lower-left, a second woman beside the rolled stone, dark empty tomb opening at right, crowd of mourners in an arc at left. Lazarus not shown, tomb empty as requested; drawn sky and rock reach every corner with no blank paper band; no lettering on any surface.

Oil painting that otherwise matches well (Jesus center-left with arm raised at the dark tomb mouth, Martha kneeling center-right, crowd in a loose arc, warm low light), but the bottom-right corner on the rock at about x 1270-1330, y 720-750 carries a painted signature-like scribble of letter forms resembling 'PANWS' in reddish strokes. Edges are fully painted.

Sepia ink sketch of a cord-tied scroll on a stone wall in the foreground with blank papyrus sheets and a clay lamp beside it, cloaks on a doorpost at left, synagogue-like facade and dusty street receding to hills. Scroll and sheets are blank; sketch reaches all four edges with no bare paper bands or corner marks.

A cursive artist-signature-style inscription in dark ink sits on the floor tiles in the bottom-right corner. Otherwise the four winged, eye-covered creatures flank a throne that is pure white blaze under a rainbow with no form inside, on a reflective glass floor that reaches all edges.

Moses stands lower-left with staff raised between two towering teal walls of water, dry rutted seabed receding to a small crowd of Israelites in the distance, a pink-orange pillar of cloud and fire rising in the night sky. God's presence shown only as the cloud-fire pillar; painting covers all four edges; no text.

Charcoal: dark churning sea in the lower half under a black void at upper left, with a burst of white light breaking through clouds at upper right and no figure or shape within it. Charcoal covers all four edges, including the near-black top-left corner and the lighter smudge at the left edge near the horizon. The thin wandering dark line at the right horizon reads as a distant shoreline, not writing.

Painterly light breaking through cloud at upper left over dark rolling waters with low mist and faint dark shoreline at right; no figure or shape within the light. Painting fills every edge, no lettering.

A brown cursive signature-like inscription is painted into the dust in the bottom-right corner. The scene itself matches: grey-haired father in brown mantle embraces the ragged barefoot son on a dirt road at center, dropped staff in the dust at lower left, farmhand at the courtyard gate at right, stone house and terraced hills behind; paint reaches all edges.

Colored-pencil hall with a winged lion, winged ox, winged man-faced figure and winged eagle, all wings studded with eyes, flanking an empty throne wrapped in a soft glowing cloud at center with a gold altar before it; floor is a mirror-polished pale marble standing in for the sea of glass. No form within the light; drawing reaches all edges; no inscriptions or marks found.

Pastel landscape: flock of sheep lying in green grass in the foreground and midground with a few grazing, a still pool at left reflecting the evening sky, a shepherd's crook and coiled sling resting on rocks at lower left, and walled village with smoke on the rise at right. No people. Painting reaches all four edges; no lettering anywhere.

Grey-haired father in running pose embraces the ragged, barefoot son around the neck and kisses his temple on a dusty road; dropped staff at lower left, stone farmhouse with two small household figures at the courtyard, terraced hills behind. No text, painting reaches all four edges.

Father in brown cloak kisses the son's temple in a tight embrace at center on a rocky road, son barefoot in a torn cloak with a pouch, staff dropped at bottom center, farmhand standing at the stone wall gate at right, houses and hills behind (a white colonnaded building sits in the left distance). Painting fills every edge and no lettering appears in any corner.

Flat-color illustration: Jesus center in blue mantle with right arm raised and mouth open toward the dark tomb at left, rolled stone beside it, Martha kneeling with clasped hands, mourners in a loose arc at right under olive trees with a village beyond. Tomb empty, Lazarus not shown; painting full to every edge; no lettering.

Painterly scene with Goliath (center-right) pitching face-first in a dust cloud, armies on both hillsides and Gath at left, but David (center) is shown mid-swing with the sling whirling overhead and its pouch still holding a grey stone, while a second stone with speed lines flies past Goliath's head: two moments and two stones in one image, and not the requested arm-extended-after-release pose. Foreground also surrounds the viewer with bronze-helmeted Philistines on both left and right. Edges fully painted, no text.

Coloured-pencil-and-ink father leaning in to embrace and kiss the bowed, barefoot son on a stony village road, staff lying in the dust at lower left, one small figure at a doorway far left, terraced hills and flat-roofed houses behind. Drawing extends to all borders with no bare paper band, no lettering.

Weathered rolled scroll tied with cord lies on a sunlit stone wall in the foreground, clay oil lamp and a stack of blank papyrus sheets at right, two undyed cloaks hanging by the doorway, village street receding to a dry hillside under a clear sky; the scroll face is blank. Pastel reaches all four edges, corners clean.

Charcoal: Daniel from behind at lower-left looking up at five wheeled thrones wrapped in rolling flame and smoke under a shaft of white light from the top edge, white-robed assembly in ranks on both sides, Babylonian rooftops behind. Ancient of Days present only as light; toned ground is worked to every corner with no bare band; no text.

Charcoal on toned paper: five Roman soldiers kneel in the foreground, the center one cupping lots in his hands with pebbles scattered on the ground, another reaching out, folded garments at bottom center, the cross with Jesus rising at upper center against dark clouds, Jerusalem walls at left and small onlookers at both sides. Hatching reaches every edge and corner; no lettering. Jesus is more visible than 'restrained shadow' but the scene is correct.

Charcoal drawing of a two-roller scroll with loose cords on a stone wall, clay lamp and pile of blank ruled sheets at left, cloaks on a doorpost, stone street and hills beyond. The sheets show only faint ruling lines, no glyphs; drawing reaches all four edges and corners.

Charcoal: Moses at left on the near shore with staff raised over the parted sea, two walls of water either side of a dry rocky seabed with tracks running to the center, Israelites small on the far bank, a pillar of fire and cloud streaking the dark sky at upper right; the presence appears only as light and cloud. Drawing reaches every edge; no lettering.

Fine white cursive signature-like script drawn in the grass at the bottom-right corner (roughly x 1255-1335, y 740-752). Otherwise a charcoal flock resting in grass around a still pool, stone village walls on the right rise, a crook and coiled sling propped against the rock at right; drawing reaches all edges.

Flat illustration of a mud-brick interior: grey-bearded older man in undyed tunic seated on a stone bench at left, a boy kneeling at a low table with an unrolled scroll, two women seated on a mat at right, open doorway with sunlit hills behind; no infant. The scroll is open rather than rolled or closed but is completely blank. Artwork reaches all four edges; no lettering or marks in corners.

Cartoon lion, ox, man-faced and eagle creatures with eye-covered wings flank an empty golden throne lit by a green-white glow with cloud and no form inside, standing on a reflective glass floor. No lettering; artwork fills all edges.

Only one six-winged seraph hovers at top center and it covers neither face nor feet, instead holding tongs with a coal (a later moment); several cartoon onlookers in colored tunics stand along both walls at bottom left and right, people the scene does not include. Isaiah with staff looks up at center-left in a gilded cedar hall with cherub reliefs; the presence is only light and cloud. Image reaches all edges, no lettering.

Charcoal courtyard: older bearded man in plain tunic seated on a stone bench at center-left, two closed scrolls on a low table, a young man and woman seated on a rug at right, open doorway to sunlit hills behind; no infant. Scrolls are blank and rolled; drawing reaches all four edges including the dark post at left; no lettering.

Oil painting: four Roman soldiers kneel in a ring at center casting lots over pebbles with garments spread on the rocks below them, Jerusalem walls and towers at right. However Jesus stands upright on the ground at upper center in front of the cross, fully clothed in white tunic and grey mantle with arms at his sides and head bowed, not crucified on it, while his clothing is being divided below: a contradictory moment. Painting reaches all four edges; no text.

Watercolor-style scroll partly unrolled on a sunlit wall with a second small roll, clay lamp and blank sheets, striped cloaks on a doorpost at left, pillared building and village street receding to dry hills. Unrolled scroll and sheets are blank; painting reaches all four edges.

Jesus in white tunic and grey mantle stands at center with right arm raised and face lifted toward the dark, empty tomb mouth with the stone rolled aside at right; a woman kneels with clasped hands at his left, a crowd of mourners in Judean dress stands in an arc at left and two more at right, warm low light. Painting reaches all edges and no marks appear in the corners.

Sepia drawing: David left with sling extended after release, Goliath tumbling head-down with legs in the air and helmeted head about to strike the ground, dust rising, spear and sword flying; Philistine ranks at right, Israelites at far left, walled city on the ridge. The giant is mid-somersault rather than collapsing face-first; toned sky and ground reach every edge; no lettering in any corner.

Pastel: warm pink-gold light breaking through cloud at upper left over dark teal water, with a low dark shoreline ridge at right and no figure in the light. At the top-left corner a grainy olive-grey band roughly 20-40 px wide runs along the left and top edges where the toned paper shows through with little pigment; it is a soft pastel fringe rather than a hard border, so whether it counts as unpainted paper is a judgment call. No lettering anywhere.

Isaiah with staff looks up at a single six-winged bronze seraph whose upper wings veil its face but whose legs and feet are bare, and it holds tongs with a glowing coal, the later moment of verse 6 rather than the stationary veiled seraphim of verse 2. Presence is shown only as light and smoke above the altar; carved winged reliefs on the frieze are decoration. No lettering, drawing fills all edges.
